Chapter 1: Fort Malus

Deep in the storm-lashed Misty Vale lie the lost ruins of Fort Malus, seat of House Stoneoak and home of a legendary apple tree said to bear fruit of pure gold. Two young dragon knights of the Keepers of the Immaculate Flame, Isadelia and Niklion, have claimed the fort with a band of cutthroat hirelings. They burned the Sathmog cultist Blutuld at the stake, hold the elf Iliel captive to translate the riddle on a sealed cellar door, and set their men digging through the keep floor. Outside, Blutuld's comrade Ossiar lurks, posing as an explorer. The heroes must sneak or fight past the wall guards and knights, solve the crystal riddle, and open the vault — where the enslaved nature spirit Rotlaug waits to wreak his overgrown revenge on the fort.
